apiKeys.intro: Keys let other systems read ProcessHub content through the public API.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.ownerHint: The person responsible for this key. The key stops working when the owner is deactivated.
apiKeys.scopesHint: Read-only. Grant only what the other system needs.
apiKeys.departmentsHint: Empty: all departments. With a selection, items without a department are left out.
apiKeys.ipHint: Optional. IP addresses or CIDR ranges, e.g. 10.20.0.0/16. Empty: any address.
apiKeys.rotateConfirm: Create a new secret? The current one stops working immediately.
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Systems using it lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.secretOnce: This is the only time the key is shown. ProcessHub stores only a fingerprint of it.
apiKeys.secretHint: Send it in the X-API-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer). Store it in the other system's secret store.
